sn56.35:1.3: “ehambho purisa, pubbanhasamayaṃ taṃ sattisatena hanissanti, majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ sattisatena hanissanti, sāyanhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanissanti.
sn56.35:1.4: so kho tvaṃ ambho purisa, divase divase tīhi tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasatassa accayena anabhisametāni cattāri ariyasaccāni abhisamessasīti.
sn56.35:2.4: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ
sn56.35:2.6: na kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave, sahadukkhena sahadomanassena catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ abhisamayaṃ vadāmi.
sn56.35:2.7: api cāhaṃ bhikkhave, sahasukhena, sahasomanassena catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ abhisamayaṃ vadāmi.
sn56.35:3.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkhanti” yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
